WITH account_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount ELSE NULL END) as avg_amt,
    AVG(t.balance) as avg_bal
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(avg_amt) as avg_of_avg_amt,
    AVG(avg_bal) as avg_of_avg_bal
  FROM account_stats
  GROUP BY region
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_of_avg_amt) as overall_mean_amt
  FROM region_stats
)
SELECT 
  r.region,
  r.avg_of_avg_amt,
  r.avg_of_avg_bal,
  r.avg_of_avg_amt / o.overall_mean_amt as ratio
FROM region_stats r
CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
WHERE o.overall_mean_amt IS NOT NULL
